body.zh-Hant: 弗里德里希·艾伯特（Friedrich Ebert）1871年2月4日生於海德堡，學的是馬具匠（Sattler）手藝。1889年他到曼海姆，在那裡接觸社會民主黨，同年8月成為漢諾威馬具匠工會的書記。後來他在不來梅擔任工會聯合會（Gewerkschaftskartell）主席，並任《不來梅市民報》的地方版編輯。1900年他當選不來梅市議會（Bürgerschaft）並領導其社會民主黨黨團；1905年他當選社民黨黨主席團的書記，遷居柏林。
body.en: Friedrich Ebert was born in Heidelberg on 4 February 1871 and trained as a saddler. In 1889 he came to Mannheim, where he was brought to Social Democracy, and in August 1889 he became secretary of the saddlers' union in Hannover. In Bremen he later chaired the trade-union cartel and worked on the local desk of the Bremer Bürger-Zeitung. Elected to the Bremen Bürgerschaft in 1900, he led its Social Democratic group; in 1905 he was elected secretary of the SPD executive and moved to Berlin.

heading.zh-Hant: 帝國議會、黨主席與議會黨團
heading.en: Reichstag, party chairmanship and parliamentary group

body.zh-Hant: 1912年艾伯特當選帝國議會議員，選區為埃爾伯費爾德—巴門。1913年9月20日他在耶拿黨代表大會上被選為社民黨主席，接續倍倍爾。哈澤（Hugo Haase）辭職後，他於1916年1月11日與謝德曼一同當選社民黨議會黨團主席。因為同時主持黨主席團、黨委員會與議會黨團，他在社民黨內取得主導性的影響力。
body.en: Ebert was elected to the Reichstag in 1912 for the constituency of Elberfeld-Barmen. On 20 September 1913 the Jena party congress elected him SPD chairman as Bebel's successor. After Haase resigned, he was elected on 11 January 1916 chairman of the SPD parliamentary group alongside Scheidemann. Because he chaired the party executive, the party committee and the parliamentary group at once, he gained a dominant influence within the SPD.

heading.en: The 1918 revolution and the Council of People's Deputies

body.zh-Hant: 1918年10月4日修憲法令通過，社民黨的一項主要目標，即帝國層級的議會化，得以實現；艾伯特主張保留君主制。11月9日，巴登親王馬克斯宣布皇帝威廉二世退位，並把帝國總理的職務交給作為最強議會黨領袖的艾伯特。11月10日，由社民黨與獨立社民黨領袖組成人民代表委員會（Rat der Volksbeauftragten），艾伯特與哈澤為對等的主席。艾伯特主張盡快選舉國民議會，並與最高陸軍指揮部（OHL）的格勒納將軍結盟。
body.en: On 4 October 1918 the constitutional amendments achieved a main goal of the Social Democrats, parliamentarisation of the Reich, while Ebert argued for keeping the monarchy. On 9 November Prince Max of Baden announced the Kaiser's abdication and handed the office of Reich Chancellor to Ebert as leader of the strongest Reichstag party. On 10 November the Council of People's Deputies was formed from SPD and USPD leaders, with Ebert and Haase as equal chairmen. Ebert argued for immediate elections to a National Assembly and allied with the Supreme Army Command under General Wilhelm Groener.

body.zh-Hant: 1919年2月11日國民議會選舉艾伯特為臨時帝國總統，同年8月21日他宣誓就職。1922年10月24日帝國議會以修憲多數把他的任期延長到1925年6月23日。1924年12月23日的判決，在法律意義上認定他因參與柏林一月罷工而犯下叛國罪。1925年2月28日他在柏林因拖延治療的盲腸炎去世，葬於海德堡。
body.en: On 11 February 1919 the National Assembly elected Ebert provisional Reich President, and he was sworn in on 21 August. On 24 October 1922 the Reichstag extended his term to 23 June 1925 with a constitution-amending majority. In a verdict of 23 December 1924 it was found, in the legal sense, that Ebert had committed treason through his part in the Berlin January strike. He died in Berlin on 28 February 1925 of a neglected appendicitis and was buried in Heidelberg.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、布拉班特公爵與軍旅
heading.en: Birth, Duke of Brabant and army training

body.zh-Hant: 利奧波德三世（Léopold III）1901年11月3日生於布魯塞爾。1909年利奧波德二世去世，阿爾貝繼位，利奧波德成為布拉班特公爵（Duke of Brabant），即比利時王位繼承人的稱號。他1915年加入陸軍第12線列團，1920年進入軍事學院，1922年任第1擲彈兵團少尉，1925年前往剛果作長途考察。
body.en: Leopold III was born in Brussels on 3 November 1901. When Leopold II died in 1909, Albert acceded to the throne and Leopold became Duke of Brabant, the title of the heir to the Belgian throne. He joined the 12th Line Regiment in 1915, entered the Military Academy in 1920, became a second lieutenant in the 1st Grenadiers in 1922, and undertook a long study trip to the Congo in 1925.

body.zh-Hant: 1926年利奧波德在斯德哥爾摩認識瑞典的阿斯特麗德公主，同年11月完婚。1930年9月7日，後來的博杜安國王出生。1934年2月23日，利奧波德三世繼承阿爾貝一世為國王。1935年，王后在瑞士庫斯納赫特的車禍中去世，國王受傷。
body.en: In 1926 Leopold met Princess Astrid of Sweden in Stockholm, and they married in November of the same year. On 7 September 1930 Prince Baudouin, the future king, was born. On 23 February 1934 Leopold III succeeded Albert I. In 1935 the Queen died in a car accident at Küssnacht in Switzerland and the King was injured.

body.zh-Hant: 1939年比利時宣布中立政策，國王希望藉此使國家免受迫近的德國威脅。1940年5月10日德國仍入侵比利時；5月28日，身為比利時陸軍總司令的國王被迫無條件投降。他的決定違背了撤往法國的政府的意願，成為後來導致他退位的「王室問題」的原因之一。
body.en: In 1939 Belgium announced a policy of neutrality, which the sovereign hoped would spare the country the imminent German threat. On 10 May 1940 Germany invaded Belgium nevertheless; on 28 May King Leopold, Commander-in-Chief of the Belgian Army, was compelled to surrender unconditionally. He took this decision against the wishes of the government, which had withdrawn to France, and it became one of the reasons for the 'Royal question' that led to his abdication.

heading.zh-Hant: 被押往德國、攝政與退位

body.zh-Hant: 1941年利奧波德與莉蓮·貝爾斯結婚。1944年6月7日，國王與家人被送往德國，後來轉往奧地利，1945年5月7日由美軍解放。他沒有立即回國，由其弟法蘭德斯伯爵查理親王繼續擔任攝政。1950年7月22日他返回布魯塞爾；1951年他放棄王位，博杜安於7月17日繼位。利奧波德三世1983年9月25日去世。
body.en: In 1941 Leopold married Lilian Baels. On 7 June 1944 the King and his family were deported to Germany and later Austria, and were liberated by American troops on 7 May 1945. He did not return at once; his brother Prince Charles, Count of Flanders, continued to rule as regent. On 22 July 1950 he returned to Brussels. In 1951 he renounced the throne and Baudouin succeeded him on 17 July. Leopold III died on 25 September 1983.

body.zh-Hant: 約瑟夫·蒂索（Jozef Tiso）1887年10月13日生於大比特恰（Vel'ká Bytča，斯洛伐克），1947年4月18日在普雷斯堡（Preßburg）去世。德國國家圖書館的人名權威檔把他記為神父與政治人物，並註明他是斯洛伐克的天主教神父。
body.en: Jozef Tiso was born in Vel'ká Bytča, Slovakia, on 13 October 1887 and died in Preßburg on 18 April 1947. The German National Library's name authority file records him as a priest and politician and notes that he was a Slovak Catholic priest.

body.zh-Hant: 同一筆權威檔註記，他曾任捷克斯洛伐克的衛生與體育部長，也是第一斯洛伐克共和國的國家總統（Staatspräsident）。
body.en: The same authority record notes that he was Czechoslovak minister of health and sport and State President of the First Slovak Republic.

body.zh-Hant: 蒂索是農民兼屠夫約瑟夫·加斯帕爾·蒂索與特蕾齊婭·蒂索娃之子。他十五歲進入尼特拉的神學院，1906至1910年在維也納修讀神學，1910年受神職，1911年獲神學博士。1914至1915年他擔任戰地神父。
body.en: Tiso was the son of the farmer and butcher Jozef Gašpar Tiso and Terézia Tisová. At fifteen he entered the priestly seminary in Nitra, studied theology in Vienna from 1906 to 1910, was ordained in 1910 and took a doctorate in theology in 1911. In 1914–15 he served as a field chaplain.

body.zh-Hant: 奧地利傳記辭典稱，蒂索先後出任該國部長與總統。他力圖依天主教社會學說建立威權的等級國家。斯洛伐克民族起義爆發時，他同意德軍入境。1945年4月他逃往阿爾特廷。他被普雷斯堡人民法院判處死刑，1947年4月被絞死。
body.en: The Austrian Biographical Lexicon says Tiso became minister and then state president. He sought to build an authoritarian corporatist state on Catholic social teaching. When the Slovak National Uprising broke out he consented to the entry of German troops. In April 1945 he fled to Altötting. A people's court in Bratislava sentenced him to death and he was hanged in April 1947.
